minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Planning Board met to announce the hiring of a new planning and economic development director and the completion of the three-year master plan steering committee process, then handled routine land-use business: an ANR endorsement, a storm water permit hearing for a proposed 4-lot subdivision on Reservoir Road with significant board concern about a common driveway's safety near a road curve, and a bond/performance guarantee for a completed home on Townsend Harbor Road. what_happened.line: The board announced a new planning and economic development director had been hired as the three-year master plan process concluded.
A public hearing on a storm water permit for a proposed 4-lot subdivision on Reservoir Road was continued to January 5 amid board concern over a shared driveway's safety near a road curve.
The board set, then accepted, a bond as a performance guarantee for a completed home on Townsend Harbor Road, contingent on the check clearing before occupancy.
The Capital Planning Committee reported it does not yet have a capital budget figure this year, expecting it later than usual due to finance department turnover.
The board endorsed an Approval Not Required plan for a West Townsend Road property.

why_it_matters: The Reservoir Road subdivision review continues into January, with the shared driveway's winter safety still unresolved before four new house lots can move forward.
A capital budget figure arriving later than usual this year may compress the town's review window once it is finally available.
The bond and ANR actions are routine land-use approvals that do not change anything residents will be asked to vote on.
